newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Chuan Soon Huat gets nod for Singapore listing.
newsitem.headline: Chuan Soon Huat gets nod for Singapore listing.

text.p: Chuan Soon Huat Industrial Group Ltd (CSH), a maker and distributor of doors, conservatories and joinery products, said on Friday it had received approval to list on the mainboard of the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
No details of the listing were given in a company statement but dealers said the initial public offering was likely to be made in early January.
The group produces a variety of doors while its joinery products include conservatories, garden gates and decorative mouldings.

Headquartered in Singapore, the company has a production base in Tangerang, Indonesia and is setting up a second factory there, which when completed in mid-1997 will raise capacity by 50 percent, the company said.
It has another facility in Kunshan, China. When completed in early 1997, its Kunshan factory and warehouse will be its manufacturing base for Asia.
CSH's net profit rose to Singapore $4.2 million in 1995 from S$0.3 million in 1992, while turnover rose to S$40.4 million from S$27.8 million.

CSH said it planned to expand its markets in Europe, North America and China. It also plans to diversify its product range using other raw materials and to diverisify into other related areas of furniture trading, renovation, furniture and contracting businesses.
